concepts.name: GRADE 10 59  The Take-off Leg Is Fully
concepts.simple_definition: GRADE 10 59  The take-off leg is fully extended;  Drive leg thigh should be nearly parallel to the ground at take-off and the foot relaxed;  The foot of the take-off leg is then pulled to the buttocks;  The drive leg rotates from in front of the body to behind it;  Take-off leg begins to pull forward;  As the thigh of the take-off leg reaches parallel, the lower portion of the leg ex- tends past the knee, with the foot dorsiflexed;  Once the leg is extended, you then forcefully drive the leg downwards, prepare yourself for an active landing
